dedupe_keys.name: component level cable and transformer cost dataset for synthetic electric distribution system analysis

description: Yushen Dong at the University of Michigan publishes cleaned component costs and technical specifications for electrical distribution cables and transformers. Two CSV tables distinguish the component classes. Missing prices have been filled using regression-based estimates and reference-table imputation, as described by the depositor. The April 2026 release is publicly available at no cost under CC BY 4.0. Geographic applicability, currency, price base year, table sizes and the detailed variable dictionary are not stated on the landing page. Global scope here indicates an unspecified synthetic-system application, not representative worldwide prices. These tables can provide assumptions for distribution-network investment and equipment-selection simulations after their units and price basis are checked. Imputed values must not be treated as observed procurement costs. No related catalogue record explicitly names this dataset. The tables and estimation accuracy were not inspected.
